claims.text: Exam under good light: inspection, digital rectal exam, abdominal exam, rectovaginal palpation.
claims.quote: Examination should be done gently and with good lighting. It consists of external inspection, perianal and intrarectal digital palpation, abdominal examination, and rectovaginal bidigital palpation.

claims.text: Anoscopy and sigmoidoscopy (15 to 60 cm above the anal verge); painful lesions may need topical, regional or general anesthesia.
claims.quote: Anoscopy and rigid or flexible sigmoidoscopy to 15 to 60 cm above the anal verge are often included

claims.text: Perineal abscess: consider a deeper perirectal abscess or Crohn disease fistula.
claims.quote: Perineal abscesses may represent cutaneous emergence of a deeper perirectal abscess or drainage resulting from Crohn disease via a fistulous tract.
